title: The moduli space of torsion-free sheaves with quasi-maximal third Chern class
summary: In this paper, we investigate the geometry of the Gieseker moduli space of semistable rank $2$ torsion-free sheaves on $\mathbb{P}^3$ with Chern classes $(c_1, c_2, c_3) = (-1, c_2, c_2^2-2)$ for $c_2 \geq 2$. We use the modular Serre correspondence to relate these moduli spaces to spaces of pairs and to suitable Hilbert schemes of one-dimensional subschemes in $\mathbb{P}^3$. For $c_2 \geq 4$, we prove that the moduli space is irreducible of dimension $c_2^2+3c_2+5$.
